info.description:
# 📄 Get started here

This template contains a boilerplate for documentation that you can quickly customize and reuse.

## 🔖 How to use this template

- Replace the content given brackets (()) with your API's details.
- Tips are formatted in `codespan` - feel free to read and remove them.
    

---

`Start with a brief overview of what your API offers.`

The ((product name)) provides many API products, tools, and resources that enable you to ((add product value here)).

`You can also list the APIs you offer, link to the relevant pages, or do both in this section.`

## **Getting started guide**

`List the steps or points required to start using your APIs. Make sure to cover everything required to reach success with your API as quickly as possible.`

To start using the ((add APIs here)), you need to -

`The points given below are from The Postman API's documentation. You can reference it to write your own getting started guide.`

- You must use a valid API Key to send requests to the API endpoints. You can get your API key from Postman's [integrations dashboard](https://go.postman.co/settings/me/api-keys).
- The API has [rate and usage limits](https://learning.postman.com/docs/developer/postman-api/postman-api-rate-limits/).
- The API only responds to HTTPS-secured communications. Any requests sent via HTTP return an HTTP 301 redirect to the corresponding HTTPS resources.
- The API returns request responses in JSON format. When an API request returns an error, it is sent in the JSON response as an error key.
    

## Authentication

`Add details on the authorization keys/tokens required, steps that cover how to get them, and the relevant error codes.`

The ((product name)) API uses ((add your API's authorization type)) for authentication.

`The details given below are from the Postman API's documentation. You can reference it to write your own authentication section.`

Postman uses API keys for authentication. You can generate a Postman API key in the [API keys](https://postman.postman.co/settings/me/api-keys) section of your Postman account settings.

You must include an API key in each request to the Postman API with the X-Api-Key request header.

### Authentication error response

If an API key is missing, malformed, or invalid, you will receive an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response code.

## Rate and usage limits

`Use this section to cover your APIs' terms of use. Include API limits, constraints, and relevant error codes, so consumers understand the permitted API usage and practices.`

`The example given below is from The Postman API's documentation. Use it as a reference to write your APIs' terms of use.`

API access rate limits apply at a per-API key basis in unit time. The limit is 300 requests per minute. Also, depending on your plan, you may have usage limits. If you exceed either limit, your request will return an HTTP 429 Too Many Requests status code.

Each API response returns the following set of headers to help you identify your use status:

| Header | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | The maximum number of requests that the consumer is permitted to make per minute. |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | The number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window. |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | The time at which the current rate limit window resets in UTC epoch seconds. |

### 503 response

An HTTP `503` response from our servers indicates there is an unexpected spike in API access traffic. The server is usually operational within the next five minutes. If the outage persists or you receive any other form of an HTTP `5XX` error, [contact support](https://support.postman.com/hc/en-us/requests/new/).

### **Need some help?**

`Add links that customers can refer to whenever they need help.`

In case you have questions, go through our tutorials ((link to your video or help documentation here)). Or visit our FAQ page ((link to the relevant page)).

Or you can check out our community forum, there’s a good chance our community has an answer for you. Visit our developer forum ((link to developer forum)) to review topics, ask questions, and learn from others.

`You can also document or add links to libraries, code examples, and other resources needed to make a request.`

item.description:
## **Sales Transfer Document**

This documentation provides a clear and easy-to-follow guide for the various transfer processes related to sales documents.

### Overview

This section covers the transfer processes related to sales documents. Below are the abbreviations used:

- `"QT"`\= **"Quotation"**
    
- `"SO"`\= **"Sales Order"**
    
- `"DO"`\= **"Delivery Order"**
    
- `"IV"`\= **"Invoice"**
    
- `"CS"`\= **"Cash Sale"**
    
- `"CN"`\= **"Credit Note"**
    

#### **Note:**

- `"SO"`can transfer from **`"QT"`**
    
- `"DO"`can transfer from **`"QT","SO"`**
    
- `"IV"`can transfer from **`"QT","SO","DO"`**
    
- `"CS"`can transfer from **`"QT","SO","DO"`**
    
- `"CN"`can transfer from **`"IV"`**
    
- **`"DocumentType"`** The documents you want tranfer to where, for example: **`"DO"`**
    
- **`"TransferFromDocumentType"`** Type of documents you want to tranfer, for example: **`"SO"`**
    
- **`"DebtorCode"`** Required if you're using **FullyDocumentTransfer,** not required if it's **PartialDocumentTransfer**.
    

#### Transfer Types

- **FullyDocumentTransfer:** Transfers all items from the source document to the target document.
    
- **PartialDocumentTransfer:** Transfers only selected items from the source document to the target document.
    

**Reminder!!! :** A document can only use one transfer type either **FullyDocumentTransfer** or **PartialDocumentTransfer** but not both.

- **`"FullDocumentNo"`**:The DocumentsNo you want to tranfer, for example: **`"SO-000001"`**  
    **Usage**: Specify the full document number when performing a **FullyDocumentTransfer**.
    

---

**`"PartialDocument"`**

**Description:** Details required for partial document transfers.

- **`"FromDocDtlKey"`**:Document Detail Key (**DtlKey**) Enter the Dtlkey of the Document you want to Transfer.  
    **How to get DtlKey:**  
    1) **SQL Database:** Query the table relevant to the document type (e.g., **`"SODTL"`** for Sales Orders).  
    2) **Postman API:** Use the GET function to retrieve the document details by **`"DocNo"`** and obtain the DtlKey.
    
- **`"Qty"`**: The quantity you want to transfer.  
    **Example:** Specify the quantity of each item you wish to transfer.
    

---

## **Purchase Transfer Document**

### Overview

This section covers the transfer processes related to purchase documents. Below are the abbreviations used:

- `"PQ"`\= "Purchase Request"
    
- `"RQ"`\= "Request Quotation"
    
- `"PO"` = "Purchase Order"
    
- `"GR"` = "Good Receive Note"
    
- `"PI"` = "Purchase Invoice"
    
- `"CP"` = "Cash Purchase"
    

#### Note:

- `"RQ"`can transfer from **`"PQ"`**
    
- `"PO"`can transfer from **`"PQ","RQ","SO"`**
    
    - "PO" transfer from "SO" need add "FromSODtlKey": \[" "\]
        
- `"GR"`can transfer from **`"RQ","PO"`**
    
- `"PI"`can transfer from **`"RQ","PO","GR"`**
    
- `"CP"`can transfer from **`"RQ","PO","GR"`**
    
- **`"DocumentType"`** The documents you want tranfer to where, for example: **`"RQ"`**
    
- **`"TransferFromDocumentType"`** Type of documents you want to tranfer, for example: **`"PQ"`**
    
- **`"DebtorCode"`** Required if you're using **FullyDocumentTransfer,** not required if it's **PartialDocumentTransfer**.
    

#### Transfer Types

- **FullyDocumentTransfer:** Transfers all items from the source document to the target document.
    
- **PartialDocumentTransfer:** Transfers only selected items from the source document to the target document.
    

**Reminder!!!:** A document can only use one transfer type either **FullyDocumentTransfer** or **PartialDocumentTransfer** but not both.

- **`"FullDocumentNo"`**:The DocumentsNo you want to tranfer, for example: **`"PQ-000001"`**  
    **Usage**: Specify the full document number when performing a **FullyDocumentTransfer**.
    

---

**`"PartialDocument"`**

**Description:** Details required for partial document transfers.

- **`"FromDocDtlKey"`**:Document Detail Key (**DtlKey**) Enter the Dtlkey of the Document you want to Transfer.  
    **How to get DtlKey:**  
    1) **SQL Database:** Query the table relevant to the document type (e.g., **`"PQDTL"`** for Purchase Request).  
    2) **Postman API:** Use the GET function to retrieve the document details by **`"DocNo"`** and obtain the DtlKey.
    
- **`"Qty"`**: The quantity you want to transfer.  
    **Example:** Specify the quantity of each item you wish to transfer.

# Debtor Maintenance

This documentation provides only common fields. Other fields may be referred directly in the respective table.

- For more detailed information, you can refer to the relevant tables in the SQL database.For example: **Debtor**
    

### **Master Information**

- \--**DebtorType (Text, 5)**: Category or type of debtor.(Optional)
    
- **CompanyName (Text, 100)**: Name of the company.(Complusory)
    
- **Decs2 (Text, 100)**: Secondary description for the company (Optional).
    
- **RegisterNo (Text, 30)**: Registration number of the company.(Optional)
    
- **ControlAccount :\*(If you want to define your own AccNo you must use this field)**
    
- **AccNo (Text, 12)**: Account number associated with the company. (If not provided, defaults to the system's default value.)
    
- **IsGroupCompany (Char, 1)**: Indicates if the company is part of a group (Use "T" for true, "F" for false).
    
- **IsActive (Char, 1)**: Indicates if the company is active (Use "T" for active, "F" for inactive).
    
- **IsCashSaleDebtor (Char, 1)**: Indicates if the company is a cash sale debtor (Use "T" for true, "F" for false).
    
- \--**TaxEntityID (Int)/ TIN (Text, 20)**: Identifier for the tax entity associated with the company. **(When you are using E-Invoice are complusory)**
    

**Note:** For fields marked with --, you'll need to set them up in maintenance before use.

### **Address Information**

- **Address1 (Text, 40)**: First line of the company’s address.(Optional)
    
- **Address2 (Text, 40)**: Second line of the company’s address.(Optional)
    
- **Address3 (Text, 40)**: Third line of the company’s address.(Optional)
    
- **Address4 (Text, 40)**: Fourth line of the company’s address.(Optional)
    
- **PostCode (Text, 10)**: Postal code for the company’s address.(Optional)
    
- \--**AreaCode (Text, 12)**: Area code associated with the company’s location (Optional).
    

**Note:** For fields marked with --, you'll need to set them up in maintenance before use.

### **Contact Information**

- **Phone1 (Text, 25)**: Primary phone number of the company.(Optional)
    
- **Phone2 (Text, 25)**: Secondary phone number of the company (Optional).
    
- **Mobile (Text, 25)**: Mobile number associated with the company (Optional).
    
- **Fax1 (Text, 25)**: Primary fax number for the company (Optional).
    
- **Fax2 (Text, 25)**: Secondary fax number for the company (Optional).
    
- **EmailAddress (Text, 200)**: Email address of the company (Optional).
    
- **WebURL (Text, 80)**: Website URL of the company (Optional).
    

### **Sales Information**

- **\--SalesAgent (Text, 12)**: Sales agent associated with the company (Optional).
    
- **\--CurrencyCode (Text, 5)**: The currency code used for financial transactions with the company (e.g., USD for US Dollars, EUR for Euros). **(If not provided, defaults to the system's default value.)**
    

### **Delivery Information**

- **DeliverAddr1 (Text, 40)**: First line of the delivery address.(Optional)
    
- **DeliverAddr2 (Text, 40)**: Second line of the delivery address.(Optional)
    
- **DeliverAddr3 (Text, 40)**: Third line of the delivery address.(Optional)
    
- **DeliverAddr4 (Text, 40)**: Fourth line of the delivery address.(Optional)
    
- **DeliverPostCode (Text, 10)**: Postal code for the delivery address.(Optional)
    

### **Additional Information**

- **Attention (Text, 40)**: Contact person for the company (Optional).
    
- **NatureOfBusiness (Text, 40)**: Description of the company's business nature (Optional).
    
- **DisplayTerm (Text, 30)**: Display term for the payment method, such as "C.O.D" (Cash On Delivery) (Optional).
    

### **Statement Information**

- **StatementType (Char, 1)**: Type of statement to be issued
    
    - `"O"` for Open item
        
    - `"B"` for Balance forward
        
    - `"N"` for None Statement
        
- **AgoingOn (Char, 1)**: Indicates the ongoing status
    
    - `"I"` for Invoice Date
        
    - `"D"` for Due Date

### Explanation of IncludeBatchBal Parameter

- **Default Value**: If not specified, `IncludeBatchBal` defaults to `false`.
    
- **When** **`IncludeBatchBal`** **is** **`false`**: Batch balance information will not be included in the response.
    
- **When** **`IncludeBatchBal`** **is** **`true`**: The response will include a `BatchBal` section with detailed batch information:
    

```
"BatchBal": [
    {
        "BatchNo": "32",
        "Location": "HQ",
        "BalQty": "12",
        "Description": "Item001",
        "ManufacturedDate": "",
        "ExpiryDate": "09/08/2024",
        "LastSaleDate": "03/05/2024"
    },
    {
        "BatchNo": "132",
        "Location": "HQ",
        "BalQty": "142",
        "Description": "Item006",
        "ManufacturedDate": "",
        "ExpiryDate": "19/08/2024",
        "LastSaleDate": "13/05/2024"
    },
        {
        "BatchNo": "37",
        "Location": "HQ",
        "BalQty": "122",
        "Description": "Item011",
        "ManufacturedDate": "",
        "ExpiryDate": "04/02/2024",
        "LastSaleDate": "02/02/2024"
    }
 ]

 ```

#### Note

- If you want the response to include batch balance information, set IncludeBatchBal to true in your API request. If you omit this parameter or set it to false, the response will exclude the BatchBal section.
    

This functionality is particularly useful for users who need detailed tracking of batch-level inventory, such as for items with expiration dates or specific manufacturing batches.

item.description:
# Item Maintenance

This documentation provides only common fields. Other fields may be referred directly in the respective table.

- For more detailed information, you can refer to the relevant tables in the SQL database.For example: _**Item**_
    

### Master Information

- **ItemCode (Text, 10)**: Unique code for the item.**(If not modified, it will follow the default value.)(Complusory)**
    
- **Description (Text, 100)**: Description of the item.(Optional)
    
- **Desc2 (Text, 100)**: Description of the item.(Optional)
    
- \--**TaxCode (Text, 10)**: Tax code applicable to the item.(Optional)
    
- \--**PurchaseTaxCode (Text, 10)**: Tax code for purchase transactions.(Optional)
    
- **LeadTime (Int)**: Lead time in days for item procurement.(Optional)
    
- \--**TariffCode (Text, 10)**: Tariff code for customs purposes (Optional).
    
- **DutyRate (Decimal)**: Duty rate applicable to the item.(Optional)
    
- **Classification (Text, 3)**: Classification code for the item.**(When you are using E-Invoice are complusory)**
    
- **CostingMethod (Char, 1)**: Method used for costing
    
    - "0" for Fixed Cost
        
    - "1" for Weighted Average
        
    - "2" for FIFO
        
    - "3" for LIFO
        
    - "4" for Most Recently
        
- **MainSupplier (Text, 12)**: Code of the main supplier for the item.(Optional)
    
- **BaseUOM (Text, 10)**: Base unit of measure for the item.
    
- **SalesUOM (Text, 10)**: Sales unit of measure for the item.
    
- **PurchaseUOM (Text, 10)**: Purchase unit of measure for the item.
    
- **ReportUOM (Text, 10)**: Reporting unit of measure for the item.
    

_**Note:**_ _For fields marked with --, you'll need to set them up in maintenance before use._

### Item Details

- **UOM (Text, 10)**: Unit of measure for the detail.**(Complusory)**
    
- **Rate (Decimal)**: Rate associated with the detail.(Optional)
    
- **Cost (Decimal)**: Cost of the item.(Optional)
    
- **MarkupPercentage (Decimal)**: Percentage markup applied.(Optional)
    
- **Price (Decimal)**: Base price of the item.(Optional)
    
- **Price2 (Decimal)**: Additional price level 2.(Optional)
    
- **Price3 (Decimal)**: Additional price level 3.(Optional)
    
- **Price4 (Decimal)**: Additional price level 4.(Optional)
    
- **Price5 (Decimal)**: Additional price level 5.(Optional)
    
- **Price6 (Decimal)**: Additional price level 6.(Optional)
    
- **MarkdownPercentage (Decimal)**: Percentage markdown applied.(Optional)
    

### Item Classification

- \--**ItemGroup (Text, 10)**: Code for the item group.**(Optional)**
    
- \--**ItemType (Text, 20)**: Type of the item.**(Optional)**
    
- **\--ItemBrand (Text, 20)**: Type of the Brand.**(Optional)**
    
- **\--ItemCategory (Text, 20)**: Type of the Category.**(Optional)**
    
- **\--ItemClass (Text, 20)**: Type of the class.**(Optional)**
    

_**Note:**_ _For fields marked with --, you'll need to set them up in maintenance before use._

### Item Status

- **IsSalesItem (Char, 1)**: Indicates if the item is a sales item (Use "T" for true, "F" for false).
    
- **IsPurchaseItem (Char, 1)**: Indicates if the item is a purchase item (Use "T" for true, "F" for false).
    
- **IsActive (Char, 1)**: Indicates if the item is active (Use "T" for active, "F" for inactive).
    
- **HasPromoter (Char, 1)**: Indicates if the item has a promoter (Use "T" for true, "F" for false).
    
- **Discontinued (Char, 1)**: Indicates if the item is discontinued (Use "T" for true, "F" for false).
    
- **AutoUOMConversion (Char, 1)**: Indicates if automatic unit of measure conversion is enabled (Use "T" for true, "F" for false).
    
- **BackOrderControl (Char, 1)**: Indicates if backorder control is enabled (Use "T" for true, "F" for false).
    
- **MustGenerateEInvoice (Char, 1)**: Indicates if electronic invoicing is required (Use "1" for yes, "0" for no).
    

### GET Item

- **IncludeBatchBal (Can fill by user (True/False)):** If **True**, it will show the result of the Item Batch.
    
- User also can filter by
    
    - ItemGroup
        
    - ItemType
        
    - ItemBrand
        
    - ItemCategory
        
    - ItemClass

item.description:
# Comman Field

This documentation provides only common fields. Other fields may be referred directly in the respective table.

- For more detailed information, you can refer to the relevant tables in the SQL database.For example: **TaxEntity**
    

#### Field Descriptions

- **TIN** (**Text**,20 required): The Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned to the taxpayer.
    
- **Name** (**Text**,100 required): The name of the business entity.
    
- **TaxClassification** (**Text**,int required): Classification code of the taxpayer based on the type of tax obligation.
    
    - 0 = Individual
        
        - **IdentityType** (**Text**,10 required(When you are using the **Individual** this is complusory))  
            exp:MyKAD
            
    - 1 = Business
        
    - 2 = Government
        
- **IdentityNo** (**Text**,30 required): The identification number of the taxpayer.
    
- **Address** (**Text**,200 required): The physical address of the taxpayer.
    
- **PostCode** (**Text**,10 required): The postal code associated with the taxpayer's address.
    
- **Phone** (**Text**,25 required): The contact phone number for the taxpayer.
    
- **EmailAddress** (**Text**,200 required): The email address for correspondence.
    
- **GSTRegisterNo** (**Text**,20 optional): The Goods and Services Tax (GST) registration number.
    
- **SSTRegisterNo** (**Text**,20 optional): The Sales and Service Tax (SST) registration number.
    
- **TradeName** (**Text**,100 required): The trade name or business name of the entity.
    
- **TourismTaxRegisterNo** (**Text**,20 optional): The registration number for tourism tax, if applicable.
    
- **BusinessActivityDesc** (**Text**,500 required): A description of the primary business activity.**(If not provided, defaults to the system's default value.)**
    
- **MSICCode** (**Text**,5 required): The Malaysian Standard Industrial Classification (MSIC) code for the business activity.
    
- **City** (**Text**,50 required): The city where the business is located.
    
- **StateCode** (**Text**,2 required): The state code corresponding to the location of the business.
    
- **CountryCode** (**Text**,3 required): The country code where the business is registered.
    
    - Example: `"MYS"` represents Malaysia.
        

#### Note

- The field names are case-sensitive. Any spelling or capitalization errors will result in a validation error.
    
- **`TIN`** (Text, 20) (Master) / **`TaxEntityID`** (Int) (Master)
    
    - TIN/TaxEntity user can pick one to fill in. If you have a duplicate TIN, you can just use TaxEntity to fill in.
        

### GET Tax Entity

- User can GET by TaxEntityID or TIN, if the got multiple same TIN then it will show all the same TIN.
    

### UPDATE/DETELE Tax Entity

- User can UPDATE/DELETE by TaxEntityID or TIN, if the got multiple same TIN then it will show got multiple same TIN so user need use TaxEntityID to update/delete

- **XFER**(Master)
    
- **XFERDTL** (Detail)
    

### Master Information

- **DocNo** (Text, 30): Document number for the stock issue.**(If not modified, it will follow the default value.)**
    
- **Description** (Text, 80): Description of the stock issue.(Optional)
    
- **RefDocNo** (Text, 20): Reference document number related to this stock issue.(Optional)
    
- **DocDate**(yyyy/MM/dd): Date of the quotation. **(If not modified, it will use the current date.)**
    

### Detail Information

This section includes detailed information about the items in the stock issue:

- **\--ItemCode** (Text, 30): Unique identifier for the item. (Compulsory)
    
- **Description** (Text, 100): Description of the item.(Optional)

- **BatchNo** (Text, 20): Batch number of the item.(Optional)
    
- **\--DeptNo** (Text, 10): Department number associated with the item.(Optional)
    
- **\--ProjNo** (Text, 10): Project number linked to the item.(Optional)

item.description: ## Common Fields - This documentation provides only common fields. Other fields may be referred directly in the respective table. - For more detailed information, you can refer to the relevant tables in the SQL database.For example: - **Quotation** - **QT (Master)** - **QTDTL (Detail)** - **Sales Order** - **SO (Master)** - **SODTL (Detail)** - **Delivery Order** - **DO (Master)** - **DODTL (Detail)** - **Invoice** - **IV (Master)** - **IVDTL (Detail)** - **Cash Sales** - **CS (Master)** - **CSDTL (Detail)** - **Credit Note** - **CN (Master)** - **CNDTL (Detail)** - **Debit Note** - **DN (Master)** - **DNDTL (Detail)** - **Delivery Return** - **DR (Master)** - **DRDTL (Detail)** - **Cancel Sales Order** - **XS (Master)** - **XSDTL (Detail)** ### Master Information - **`--DebtorCode`**(Text,12):Unique identifier for the debtor. **(Compulsory)** (If processed in Debtor Maintenance, the other fields (**if populated**) will be populated in there) - **`DebtorName`**(Text,100): Name of the debtor. - **`InvAddr1`**(Text,40): First line of the invoice address. - **`InvAddr2`**(Text,40): Second line of the invoice address. - **`InvAddr3`**(Text,40): Third line of the invoice address. - **`InvAddr4`**(Text,40):Fourth line of the invoice address. - **`DocNo`**(Text,30): Quotation number. **(If not modified, it will follow the default value.)** - **`DocDate`**(yyyy/MM/dd): Date of the quotation. **(If not modified, it will use the current date.)** - **`DeliveryTerm`**(Text,40): Terms related to delivery.**(Optional)** - **`PaymentTerm`**(Text,40): Payment terms for the debtor.**(Optional)** - **`--SalesAgent`**(Text,12): Sales agent associated with the debtor.**(Optional)** - **`--ShipVia`**(Text,20): Shipping method used.**(Optional)** - **`--ShipInfo`**(Text,40): Information related to shipping.**(Optional)** - **`--SalesLocation`**(Text,8): Sales location for the debtor.**(Optional)** - **`MultiPrice`**(Text,8): Indicates if multiple pricing levels are used.**(Optional)** - **`OurInvoiceNo`** (Text,60): Unique identifier for the invoice generated by the system.**(Optional)** **Note:** For fields marked with --, you'll need to set them up in maintenance before use. ### More Header **Note:** For **More Header** , can empty (**Optional**) #### Document Information - **`Description`**(Text,80): Description of the document or transaction.(**If not modified, it will follow the last document value.)** - **`Ref`**(Text,40): Reference information. - **`RefDocNo`**(Text,20): Reference document number. - **`Remark1`**(Text,40): Additional remark 1. - **`Remark2`**(Text,40): Additional remark 2. - **`Remark3`**(Text,40): Additional remark 3. - **`Remark4`**(Text,40): Additional remark 4. #### Customer Information - **`Attention`**(Text,40): Contact person for the customer. - **`Phone1`**(Text,25): Primary phone number of the customer. ##### Delivery Information - **`Fax1`**(Text,25): Primary fax number of the customer. - **`DeliverAddr1`**(Text,40): First line of the delivery address. - **`DeliverAddr2`**(Text,40): Second line of the delivery address. - **`DeliverAddr3`**(Text,40): Third line of the delivery address. - **`DeliverAddr4`**(Text,40): Fourth line of the delivery address. - **`DeliverPhone1`**(Text,25): Primary phone number for delivery. - **`DeliverFax1`**(Text,25): Primary fax number for delivery. - **`DeliverContact`**(Text,40): Contact person for delivery. ##### Sales Tax Exemption - **`SalesExemptionNo`**(Text,80): Sales exemption number. - **`SalesExemptionExpiryDate`**(yyyy/MM/dd): Expiry date for the sales exemption. ## Details Information This section includes detailed information about the items: - **`--ItemCode`**(Text,30): Unique identifier for the item. (If processed in **Stock Item Maintenance**, the other fields **(if populated)** will be populated in there) - **`UOM`**(Text,8): Unit of measure for the item, such as PCS (pieces), BOX (boxes), or LTR (liters). - **`UnitPrice`**(Decimal,25,8): Price per unit of the item. - **`Description`**(Text,100): Description of the item. - **`Desc2`**(Text,100): Additional description for the item - **`FurtherDescription`**(Text,max): Further details about the item.**(Optional)** - **`DeliveryDate`**(yyyy/MM/dd): Expected delivery date for the item.**(If not modified, it will use the current date.)** - **`--Location`**(Text,8): Location where the item is stored.**(Optional)** - **`--DeptNo`**(Text,10): Department number associated with the item.**(Optional)** - **`--ProjNo`**(Text,10): Project number linked to the item.**(Optional)** - **`Qty`**(Decimal,25,8): Quantity of the item.**(Optional)** - **`Discount`**(Text,20): Discount applied to the item.**(Optional)** - **`--TaxCode`**(Text,14): Tax code applicable to the item. - **`SalesExemptionNo`**(Text,60): Sales exemption number if applicable.**(Optional)** - **`Classification`** (Text, 3): Classification code for the item.**(When you are using E-Invoice are complusory)** **Note:** For fields marked with **(**\--**)**, you'll need to set them up in maintenance before use. ## E-Invoice Fields - **`DocStatus`**(Char, 1)(Master) (DocStatus default is **Draft**) - Draft = D - Approved = A - AwaitingApproval = P - Expired = E - Rejected = R - Void = V - **`SubmitEInvoice`** (Char, 1)(Master) **(Can fill in by User T/F)**(Default is T) - **`ConsolidatedEInvoice`** (Char, 1)(Master) **(Can fill in by User T/F)**(Default is T) - **`Classification`** (Text, 3)(Detail) **(Can fill in by User)(Complusory)** - **`TIN`** (Text, 20) (Master) / **`TaxEntityID`** (Int) (Master) - TIN/TaxEntityID user can pick one to fill in. If you have a duplicate TIN, you can just use TaxEntity to fill in. #### Reminder When the E-invoice status = Valid , it can no be update any more except the information are not important exp: BatchNo. - \- **`SubmitEinvoice`**: **T** ; **`DocStatus`**: **D** wont submit \- **`SubmitEinvoice`**: **F** ; **`DocStatus`**: **A** wont submit \- **`SubmitEinvoice`**: **T** and **`DocStatus`**: **A** it will Submit - Now is not allow update to these status - **P** (AwaitingApproval) - **E** (Expired) - **R** (Rejected) - **V** (Void) - Cash Sales dont have the **DocStatus** - If you need to cancel document was submit to LHDN must include **`"EinvoiceCancelReason"`** ## Non-Usable Fields This section explains fields that are not usable in the current API version. These fields will be ignored, and their values will not be processed. - **`SubTotal`**(Decimal,19,2) - **`TaxRate`**(Decimal,18,6) - **`TaxCurrencyTax`**(Decimal,19,2) - **`LocalSubTotalExTax`**(Decimal,19,2) - **`TaxCurrencyTaxableAmt`**(Decimal,19,2) ### Field Requirements Based on ItemCode Input If ItemCode is Provided When ItemCode is provided, the following fields are compulsory: - **`"ItemCode"`** - **`"Description"`** - **`"UOM"`** - **`"UnitPrice"`** If ItemCode is Not Provided When ItemCode is not provided, the following fields are compulsory: - **`"Description"`** **If ItemCode is not provided** `Description`**particularly important and complusory !** Note: Ensure that you have set up Tax Code Maintenance.

item.description: ## Common Fields - This documentation provides only common fields. Other fields may be referred directly in the respective table. - For more detailed information, you can refer to the relevant tables in the SQL database.For example: - **Request Quotation** - **RQ (Master)** - **RQDTL (Detail)** - **Purchase Order** - **PO (Master)** - **PODTL (Detail)** - **Good Receive Note** - **GR (Master)** - **GRDTL (Detail)** - **Purchase Invoice** - **PI (Master)** - **PIGTL (Detail)** - **Cash Purchase** - **CP (Master)** - **CPDTL (Detail)** - **Purchase Return** - **PR (Master)** - **PRDTL (Detail)** - **Good Return** - **GT (Master)** - **GTDTL (Detail)** ### Master Information - **`--CreditorCode`**(Text,12):Unique identifier for the Creditor. **(Compulsory)** (If processed in Creditor Maintenance, the other fields (**if populated**) will be populated in there) - **`CreditorName`**(Text,100): Name of the creditor. - **`InvAddr1`**(Text,40): First line of the invoice address. - **`InvAddr2`**(Text,40): Second line of the invoice address. - **`InvAddr3`**(Text,40): Third line of the invoice address. - **`InvAddr4`**(Text,40):Fourth line of the invoice address. - **`DocNo`**(Text,30): Document number. **(If not modified, it will follow the default value.)** - **`Date`**(dd/MM/yyyy): Date of the Purchase. **(If not modified, it will use the current date.)** - **`DeliveryTerm`**(Text,40): Terms related to delivery.**(Optional)** - **`PaymentTerm`**(Text,40): Payment terms for the creditor.**(Optional)** - **`--SalesAgent`**(Text,12): Sales agent associated with the creditor.**(Optional)** - **`--ShipVia`**(Text,20): Shipping method used.**(Optional)** - **`--ShipInfo`**(Text,40): Information related to shipping.**(Optional)** - **`--SalesLocation`**(Text,8): Sales location for the creditor.**(Optional)** **Note:** For fields marked with --, you'll need to set them up in maintenance before use. ### More Header **Note:** For **More Header** , can empty **(Optional)** #### Document Information - **`Description`**(Text,80): Description of the document or transaction.(**If not modified, it will follow the default value.** ) - **`Ref`**(Text,40): Reference information. - **`RefDocNo`**(Text,20): Reference document number. - **`Remark1`**(Text,40): Additional remark 1. - **`Remark2`**(Text,40): Additional remark 2. - **`Remark3`**(Text,40): Additional remark 3. - **`Remark4`**(Text,40): Additional remark 4. #### Customer Information - **`Attention`**(Text,40): Contact person for the customer. - **`Phone1`**(Text,25): Primary phone number of the customer. ##### Delivery Information - **`Fax1`**(Text,25): Primary fax number of the customer. - **`DeliverAddr1`**(Text,40): First line of the delivery address. - **`DeliverAddr2`**(Text,40): Second line of the delivery address. - **`DeliverAddr3`**(Text,40): Third line of the delivery address. - **`DeliverAddr4`**(Text,40): Fourth line of the delivery address. - **`DeliverPhone1`**(Text,25): Primary phone number for delivery. - **`DeliverFax1`**(Text,25): Primary fax number for delivery. - **`DeliverContact`**(Text,40): Contact person for delivery. ## Details Information This section includes detailed information about the items: - **`--ItemCode`**(Text,30): Unique identifier for the item. (If processed in **Stock Item Maintenance**, the other fields **(if populated)** will be populated in there) - **`UOM`**(Text,8): Unit of measure for the item, such as PCS (pieces), BOX (boxes), or LTR (liters). - **`UnitPrice`**(Decimal,25,8): Price per unit of the item. - **`Description`**(Text,100): Description of the item. - **`Desc2`**(Text,100): Additional description for the item - **`FurtherDescription`**(Text,max): Further details about the item.**(Optional)** - **`DeliveryDate`**(dd/MM/yyyy): Expected delivery date for the item.**(If not modified, it will use the current date.)** - **`--Location`**(Text,8): Location where the item is stored.**(Optional)** - **`--DeptNo`**(Text,10): Department number associated with the item.**(Optional)** - **`--ProjNo`**(Text,10): Project number linked to the item.**(Optional)** - **`Qty`**(Decimal,25,8): Quantity of the item.**(Optional)** - **`Discount`**(Text,20): Discount applied to the item.**(Optional)** - **`--TaxCode`**(Text,14): Tax code applicable to the item.**(Optional)** - **`SalesExemptionNo`**(Text,60): Sales exemption number if applicable.**(Optional)** - **`AccNo`**(Text,12): GL code.**(Optional)** **Note:** For fields marked with **(**\--**)**, you'll need to set them up in maintenance before use. ## Non-Usable Fields This section explains fields that are not usable in the current API version. These fields will be ignored, and their values will not be processed. - **`SubTotal`**(Decimal,19,2) - **`TaxRate`**(Decimal,18,6) - **`TaxCurrencyTax`**(Decimal,19,2) - **`LocalSubTotalExTax`**(Decimal,19,2) - **`TaxCurrencyTaxableAmt`**(Decimal,19,2) ### Field Requirements Based on ItemCode Input If ItemCode is Provided When ItemCode is provided, the following fields are compulsory: - **`"ItemCode"`** - **`"Description"`** - **`"UOM"`** - **`"UnitPrice"`** If ItemCode is Not Provided When ItemCode is not provided, the following fields are compulsory: - **`"Description"`** **If ItemCode is not provided** `Description`**particularly important and complusory !** - **`"UOM"`** - **`"Qty"`** - **`"UnitPrice"`** - **`"TaxCode"`** Note: Ensure that you have set up Tax Code Maintenance.

item.name: E-Invoice Status
item.description:
# **Get E-Invoice Status**

### **Common Fields:**

This section explains the common fields required for filtering E-Invoice data.

---

- `DateFrom` (yyyy/MM/dd): Start date for filtering documents.
    
- `DateTo` (yyyy/MM/dd): End date for filtering documents.
    
- `SubmissionDateFrom` (yyyy/MM/dd): Start date for filtering by submission date.
    
- `SubmissionDateTo` (yyyy/MM/dd): End date for filtering by submission date.
    
- `SubmissionTimeFrom` (hh:mm:ss): Start time for filtering submission time.**(Optional)**
    
- `SubmissionTimeTo` (hh:mm:ss): End time for filtering submission time.**(Optional)**
    
- `DocType` (Text): List of document types to filter. Valid values include: **(Compulsory)**
    
    - `IV`: Invoice
        
    - `CS`: Cash Sales
        
    - `DN`: Debit Note
        
    - `CN`: Credit Note
        
    - `SB`: Self-Billing
        
    - `CI`: Consolidated E-Invoice
        
- `EInvoiceStatus` (Text): Status of E-Invoice documents to filter. Valid values include:**(Compulsory)**
    
    - `Valid`
        
    - `Invalid`
        
    - `Cancelled`
        
    - `Pending`
        
    - `Failed`
        
    - `Submitted`
        
    - `None`
        

---

### **Field Notes**

- **Filter Date Requirement**: At least one of the following date ranges must be provided:  
    If neither is provided, the system will return an error.
    
    - `DateFrom` and `DateTo`
        
    - `SubmissionDateFrom` and `SubmissionDateTo`
        
- Ensure `DateFrom`/`DateTo` and `SubmissionDateFrom`/`SubmissionDateTo` are in their correct formats to avoid errors.
    
- `DocType` and `EInvoiceStatus` support multiple values for filtering.

item.description:
# **Common Fields**

## **Self-Billing Document**

This section provides the common fields for the Self-Billing Document. For additional details, refer to the respective SQL database tables:

- Self-Billing Master: **SB**
    
- Self-Billing Details: **SBDTL**
    

---

### **Master Information**

- `SupplierTaxEntityID` (Text, 20): Unique identifier for the supplier’s tax entity. (**Compulsory)**
    
- `DocNo` (Text, 30): Self-Billing document number. (If not modified, it will follow the default value.)
    
- `DocDate` (yyyy/MM/dd): Date of the Self-Billing document. (If not modified, it will use the current date.)
    
- `FrequencyOfBilling` (Text, 20): Frequency of billing (e.g., Monthly, Weekly). **(Optional)**
    
- `BillingPeriodStartDate` (yyyy/MM/dd): Start date of the billing period. **(Optional)**
    
- `BillingPeriodEndDate` (yyyy/MM/dd): End date of the billing period. **(Optional)**
    
- `SupplierInvoiceNo` (Text, 40): Invoice number provided by the supplier. **(Optional)**
    

##### Note

`SupplierTaxEntityID` (Int) (Master) / `SupplierTIN` (Text, 20) (Master)

- SupplierTIN/SupplierTaxEntityID user can pick one to fill in. If you have a duplicate SupplierTIN, you can just use TaxEntity to fill in.
    

---

### **Details Information**

This section includes detailed information about the items in the Self-Billing document.

- `Classification` (Text, 3): Classification code for the item.**(Compulsory)**
    
- `Description` (Text, 100): Description of the item.**(Compulsory)**
    
- `Measurement` (Decimal, 25, 8): Measurement value for the item (e.g., weight, volume).**(Compulsory)**
    
- `Qty` (Decimal, 25, 8): Quantity of the item.**(Optional)**
    
- `Discount` (Decimal, 25, 8): Discount amount for the item.**(Optional)**
    
- `DiscountReason` (Text, 40): Reason for the discount applied.**(Optional)**
    
- `Charge` (Decimal, 25, 8): Additional charge for the item. **(Optional)**
    
- `ChargeReason` (Text, 40): Reason for the additional charge.**(Optional)**
    

## E-Invoice Fields

#### Reminder

When the E-invoice status = Valid , it can no be update any more except the information are not important exp: BatchNo.

- **`DocStatus`**(Char, 1)(Master) (DocStatus default is Approve)
    
    - Draft = D
        
    - Approved = A
        
    - AwaitingApproval = P
        
    - Expired = E
        
    - Rejected = R
        
    - Void = V
        
- \- **`SubmitEinvoice`**: **T** ; **`DocStatus`**: **D** wont submit  
    \- **`SubmitEinvoice`**: **F** ; **`DocStatus`**: **A** wont submit  
    \- **`SubmitEinvoice`**: **T** and **`DocStatus`**: **A** it will Submit
    
- Now is not allow update to these status
    
    - **P** (AwaitingApproval)
        
    - **E** (Expired)
        
    - **R** (Rejected)
        
    - **V** (Void)
        
- If you need to cancel document was submit to LHDN must include  
    **`"EinvoiceCancelReason"`**
